annotations.title: Track findings as one or keep them separate

description: Choose whether findings with the same root cause, such as the same flaw reported again by a later pentest, are tracked as one (one fix, the others folded under the primary finding in the list) or kept separate, as the Findings page's Track as one and Keep separate actions do. A person's choice wins over Odin's own grouping from then on. Returns the groups that now hold the chosen findings. Requires the Member role or above and write permission; acts as the API key creator.

action.description: track_as_one tracks the findings as one issue with one fix; keep_separate keeps them as separate issues, whatever Odin detects later.

findingIds.description: findingId values (not identifiers such as ODI-12) from list_findings or get_finding.

primaryFindingId.description: track_as_one only: the finding where the fix belongs. Defaults to the highest-severity open finding.

separatedFindingId.description: keep_separate only: take just this finding out of the group, keeping the rest together.
